summary: AmBase filed an 8-K disclosing a letter agreement with CEO Richard Bianco (RAB) on July 30, 2026, under which RAB paid an additional $1,000,000 for working capital and litigation expenses relating to the 111 West 57th Property, on the same terms as the March 2026 Litigation Funding Agreement (up to $6,000,000 initial). The funding is insider-provided, with repayment prioritized from litigation recoveries, reflecting the company's going-concern qualification. The filing notes the company continues exploring strategic alternatives, including capital raises or sales. Watch for further financing, litigation outcomes, or potential restructuring; risk-arb angle limited as not a transactional deal.
